description: Rehberger disclosed account takeover vulnerability in DeepSeek AI through session/token handling weakness.

Embrace The Red showed that DeepSeek's web chat could be driven by prompt injection to execute script in the page (XSS); the script could read the userToken stored in localStorage on chat.deepseek.com, which was all that was needed to take over a user's session.

description: Unit 42 assessed Shai-Hulud npm supply chain worm campaign used LLM to generate malicious scripts that compromised hundreds of packages including Crowdstrike, Postman, and Zapier.

Unit 42 investigated the self-replicating Shai-Hulud npm worm, responsible for the compromise of hundreds of software packages, and assessed with moderate confidence that an LLM was used to generate the malicious bash script, based on its comments and emojis.
